verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection are fair questions for a serverless and storage platform, but the evidence pack never documents a way to choose where data is stored. The only nearby material is Smart Placement, which moves compute closer to data to cut latency, and 'globally distributed' storage. Neither is a user-selectable storage region or residency control, so both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
